BrochureContent.Content:
A rare opportunity to acquire two traditional detached cottages and site, offering enormous potential in a peaceful countryside setting.

The site enjoys a sunny aspect with ample off-street parking, mature trees, and a gently rising backdrop that provides privacy and a wonderful rural atmosphere. With both cottages positioned separately on the site, the property lends itself to a variety of uses, whether for multi-generational living, holiday accommodation, or investment.

Accommodation consists of:
Cottage 1: Kitchen/Dining Room, Living Room, 2 Bedrooms, Bathroom

Cottage 2: Kitchen/Dining Room, Living Room, 1 Bedroom, Bathroom

Two detached traditional cottages included in the sale
Excellent renovation and refurbishment opportunity
Separate buildings offering flexible accommodation options
Ample parking
Mature setting with countryside views
10 minute drive to the thriving town of Midleton
